$comment: Packages whose newer major versions moved to a commercial licence. Staying on the last free version means no more security patches, so the report lists each one as replace-needed. 'commercialFrom' is the first version under the commercial licence; 'kind: watch' means the licence is free under conditions that must be re-checked. Verify licence terms at 'licenseUrl' before acting.
